title: Te Reo i Karanga ki te Tika
intro: I te whenua tawhito o Miriana, i te wāhi i tupu ai te hokohoko, i haereere ai ngā tira haereere i roto i ngā koraha whānui, ka ara ake tētahi poropiti a Allah i roto i te iwi kua kotiti ke i te ara o te tika. I tonoa tēnei pononga a Allah me tētahi misioni atua hei whakamātautau i te whakapono o tētahi hapori katoa. I roto i ngā whakamātautau o te manawanui me te manawanui, i tū pakari tēnei wairua ki te tuku i tētahi whakatūpato ka rangona puta noa i te hītori. Ka taea e koe te wetewete i te mea ngaro o tēnei karere u?
clues: I whiriwhiria ahau e Allah hei arahi i tētahi iwi kua wareware ki ngā mātāpono o te tika me te pono i roto i ā rātou mahi.
I tuku karere ahau e karanga ana i tōku hapori kia kaua e karakia ki tetahi atu engari ki a Allah, kia kōrero pono hoki i ngā mea katoa.
I whakatūpato ahau mō te mahi pirau o te kai taonga mā ngā huarahi turekore, ā, i whakanui hoki i te hiranga o ngā pauna me ngā mehua tika.
I whakautu mai tōku iwi ki aku whakatūpato me te tawai, me te whakawehi ka pei i ahau i tō rātou whenua mēnā ka haere tonu taku karere.
Ahakoa tō rātou mauahara, i u tonu ahau ki taku kaupapa, me te kī ko Allah anake te utu mōku.
I hopukia tōku iwi e te whiu nui, ko ahau ia i whakaorangia e te aroha noa o tōku Ariki, i te mea kua oti taku misioni.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te anga atu ki tētahi iwi i whakakahore i te pono, i whakawehi hoki i te whiu mō te kawe i te karere a Allah
Te kitenga i te Waipuke Nui i whakangaro i te hunga whakaponokore o tētahi iwi
Te whiwhi i te whakakitenga i a koe e haere ana i roto i te awaawa o
Te whakamātautau i te whakapono i te wā i ngana ai te rangatira tukino ki te whakamutu i te karanga ki te whakapono kotahi
He iwi e tono ana kia ua i te wā o te tauraki nui i muri i ngā tau maha o te kore whakarongo
trial.answer: Te anga atu ki tētahi iwi i whakakahore i te pono, i whakawehi hoki i te whiu mō te kawe i te karere a Allah

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ko te whenua o Miriana, te wāhi i hokohoko ai taku iwi, i hokohoko ai
Ko te papa o tētahi kaipuke nui i whakaora i te hunga whakapono i tētahi waipuke nui
He ana i roto i te maunga toka i rapu piringa ai ngā taiohi tokowhitu i te whakatoi
Te tāone tapu o Hiruharama i haria ai ahau mō tētahi haerenga pō
He whare rangatira i Hepa i reira tētahi kingitanga nui i whakarite ai ki te kite i tētahi tohu atua
location.answer: Ko te whenua o Miriana, te wāhi i hokohoko ai taku iwi, i hokohoko ai

outcome.label: Hua
options: I hopukia tōku iwi e te whiu kino, i ahau e whakaorangia ana, nā te mea kua tutuki i ahau taku kawenga ki a Allah.
I hurihia te hunga whakateka hei makimaki i a rātou e takahi ana i ngā rohe tapu o Allah.
I awhi ōku hoariri i te whakapono i muri i te kitenga i tētahi panonitanga whakamiharo
I manaakitia te whenua ki te ua nui me te rawa i muri i te ripeneta o te iwi
I whakamatea ahau e tōku ake iwi mō te kore e whakarērea taku misioni
outcome.answer: I hopukia tōku iwi e te whiu kino, i ahau e whakaorangia ana, nā te mea kua tutuki i ahau taku kawenga ki a Allah.
